question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **had**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage is given in the **past tense**.
 
• The use of **had **is appropriate here.
 
• Had is used as the **main verb** here.
 
• It is a** transitive verb**, and must therefore be followed by **a direct object**. 
 
• The direct object of to have can be **a noun, a noun group, a pronoun or a numeral**.
 
• Hence, the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3 is **option 2**.
